summary: Keurig Dr Pepper filed a preliminary 424B5 for a $2.0 billion primary common stock offering at an undisclosed price; shares last traded at $38.25 on November 11, 2026. Underwriters Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley hold a 30-day option for up to $300 million of additional shares. Proceeds are not yet specified in the excerpt. The filing references an intended tax-free spin-off separating beverage and coffee businesses and the JDE Peet's acquisition. Watch pricing, discount to last sale, use of proceeds toward leverage, and spin-off timing.
